description: Turn one Smart Filter on a smart object, or all of them, off or on (the eye icons under the layer in the Layers panel)

index.description: Which filter, 1 = the first listed by get_smart_object_info. Default all

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: set_smart_filter_visibility
title: Set Smart Filter Visibility
